title: Migrate a copy of the account store
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Version the SQLite account and credential model with immutable IDs. Keep existing homes and preferences addressable. Define authoritative profile fields, lifecycle state and private avatar storage.

**Verify** · Upgrade and retry a copied owner/member store, interrupt migration, and demonstrate recovery from backup. IDs, roles and member data survive. Incompatible versions fail clearly.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-055

**Queue** · Follows WI-055 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
